Initial release – calculate, interpret, and improve unit economics for solopreneurs.

- Guides users through CAC, LTV, payback period, and contribution margin calculations.
- Provides clear formulas, real-world examples, and benchmarks for healthy, concerning, and critical metrics.
- Offers actionable levers to improve unit economics, prioritized by impact.
- Includes monthly dashboard templates for ongoing tracking.
- Covers both subscription and non-subscription business models.
- Designed to trigger on key phrases like "unit economics," "LTV," "CAC," "payback period," and related profitability questions.
